claims.claim: Contact us for ur Solar Energy Solution...
claims.evidence: The witness report only shows a solar panel array photo; it does not confirm the seller’s offer details, specifications, or any working/performance claims.

risks.risk: Wattage/rating is unknown, so the panel’s true value cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the panel’s label/sticker showing wattage (W), voltage/current (V/A), and model number (or a readable serial/ID).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified/unknown-rated used solar module (worst-case) with no performance guarantee.

risks.risk: Brand/model and serial number are not visible, so authenticity and replacement compatibility are uncertain.
risks.proof: A close-up of the manufacturer label/serial plate on the frame/back (or any readable markings).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown brand used panel with no warranty and uncertain compatibility.

risks.risk: Physical condition (micro-cracks, delamination, scratches, water ingress) cannot be assessed from the current view.
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of the full front and back, taken at angles to reveal cracks/crazing, plus a close-up of the junction box area and any cable entry points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/defective until condition is proven.

risks.risk: Electrical/connector condition is unknown (junction box, MC4 connectors, cable length, corrosion).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the junction box and connectors (MC4 or equivalent), including any visible corrosion, loose wiring, or damaged cable ends.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing connector/cable replacement risk.

risks.risk: It’s unclear whether this is a single panel or part of a larger array/system; quantity affects total value.
risks.proof: A wider shot showing the full setup and how many panels/modules are included, plus a count of panels in the array.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case assumption for quantity (single module) unless the full count is shown.

risks.risk: No performance test data is provided; output under load may be low due to aging or damage.
risks.proof: A performance measurement screenshot/photo (IV curve or measured wattage under standard test conditions) or a working demonstration with a multimeter/solar tester reading.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the panel label showing brand, model, and wattage rating (W) plus serial/ID.
Send front and back photos at angles to check for cracks/micro-cracks/delamination and water ingress.
Send close-ups of the junction box and connectors (MC4 or equivalent) and the cable length/condition.
Send a wider shot to confirm whether it is a single panel or the full array (count of modules).
Provide any test result (measured output/wattage or IV curve) or a working demonstration reading.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a solar photovoltaic panel/module, but key pricing drivers (wattage/model, condition, connectors, and performance) are not readable or shown. Without at least the rating label and condition proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
